normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- 6 passenger golf cart- Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $25 per day**- 5 adult bikes - Screened-in porch- Spacious balcony with forest views - Hallway bunks- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- Firepit - Sonos system- Grill- Premium, stainless-steel appliances- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Cheers to the memories made at "White Sands and Suntans!" This exquisite 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home is located in WaterColor's Forest District. With stark white walls and furnishings with accents of coastal blue throughout, this cheerful home captures the feel of a Florida cottage while still maintaining its elegance. Surrounded by forest views, this home has ultimate privacy from the pool area and plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors. The first floor is welcomed by an open kitchen and living area with a flat-screen TV, access to the screened-in porch, and seating for 8 at the dinner table and 5 at the breakfast bar. There is a guest bathroom down the hall adjacent to the secondary living room and first guest room with 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds and a sleeper sofa. Upstairs, there is a set of twin-over-twin bunk beds in the hallway that separates the primary suite from the remaining guest rooms. The primary suite features private access to the balcony, sitting area, and private bathroom. The final 2 bedrooms feature a king and queen bed with private bathrooms. The corner balcony on the second floor is a cozy spot to enjoy the Gulf breeze and find a moment of serenity with a view of the Florida pine trees surrounding the home. Guests are just a short walk or bike ride to the many amenities around WaterColor's neighborhood including tennis courts, nature paths, playgrounds, and The Boathouse. It's also near Publix and the retail and dining options at the WaterColor Crossings center. Don't miss your chance to stay in this fabulous WaterColor home!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk beds and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Hallway Bunk: Twin over Twin Bunk bedWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
